datas.en: Level cap reached. Evolve to uncap

After thorough research and validation, your first mate Grigory confirmed that his hairstyle is perceived by AI enemies as a hard headgear, causing them to avoid targeting it.
Grigory attempted to issue orders for your troops to adopt his hairstyle.
To prevent this from happening, during that period, the survey question "How do you wish to die?" was commonly answered with "shot in the head".

Since the beginning of this century, the cold north has become uninhabitable for humans, with only a few remaining on the increasingly frozen continents.
In recent years, "Northerners" have gradually moved south, integrating into normal human society, and the north has grown quieter, as if devoid of life.
It wasn't until this guy came south that we realized the Abyss Empire had sent more than one batch of troops to the cold north.
If what he says is true, and his combat skills are not outstanding among the current "Northerners," it's likely that the troops sent by the Abyss Empire never returned.

Hmm... Alexia thinks that since we're the Sperm Whale trio, we should have a unified feature for recognition...
Right... So she wears demon horns, Little Biter wears a shark helmet, and I wear a cat ear helmet, but the latter two don't quite fit, I think...
Don't ask! My helmet is removable! I just... don't want to take it off for now! (sobbing)

Wearing the Crown of Lightning
Unleashing a radiant dragon
Clad in a crimson holy robe
Enemies turn to ashes at his touch
As humanity wails
The darkest of times comes
Behold! The crimson god of war dances with thunder.

Before the catastrophe, vicious criminals were often slapped by him, and no one ever received a second slap. The surviving prisoners claimed that one slap was enough.
After the catastrophe, the cruel enemies of the Abyss Empire were often slapped by him, and no enemy survived.

The enemy tide covered the coast; it wasn't vast but dense, like red tassels fluttering in the wind. As the wind blew stronger, it wove into a tapestry, gradually obscuring the limited view of the fortifications. The wind grew fiercer, and the tapestry fiercely lashed against the soldiers' faces, forcing them to press their heads tightly against their armor. The wind howled, and a cherry-colored blade flashed. In an instant, the cherry hue intertwined with the tapestry, which ceased to move.

In an era of rapid advancements in AI biotechnology, it is the most precious star, becoming the mascot of this technology as a national treasure from the East.
After acquiring AI, it crafted armor for itself and ventured further down the path of honing combat skills.
The researchers regret showing it an old animated film about pandas and martial arts.
Now, no one can defeat it!

Once a perpetually burning meteorite, after crashing to Earth, it gained consciousness through the engineer Victor's obsession with silicon-based life and the enhancement of AI.
It wanted to join the human resistance but was driven away as a monster that killed its father, Victor.
It tried to pick flowers for a crying orphan it had just saved, but the flowers turned to ashes the moment they were picked.
Every time it charged into battle to help humans, it was mistaken for a new weapon of the Abyss Empire and was hit by humans even more.
The heat prevented it from embracing the humans it loved, so it embraced the enemies of humanity instead.

Thank you for accepting him.

The Mech Emperor is the name given by the Mech Combat Alliance, undefeated in the arena and never revealing his true identity. This led people to believe he might actually be an AI controlling the mech.
After the apocalypse, he appeared on the battlefield, using his signature moves from the arena to defeat enemy troops.
His mystery only adds to his allure, now the dream of countless surviving girls. As long as he's not truly just an AI, they're willing.

The dying quantum scientist Joaquin gently stroked his daughter Joelle's head in a pool of blood. Once the Abyssling broke down the lab door and killed the father and daughter, the city's living population would be reduced to zero.

"Dad said he's leaving." Sitting atop a pile of scrapped Abyssling mechs, Joelle told the astonished rescue team, "I said I wanted to go with him, but he refused."
Her voice was low and weak yet eerily calm, as if the destruction of the city by the Abyssling had nothing to do with her.
She continued, "I said, if you leave, I can't survive anyway... but he shook his head, looked at me, and smiled, saying he had a way." At this point, she turned to look at a scrapped device not far away.
She fell silent, leaving the rescue team bewildered.
After a moment of stalemate, a team member attempted to help the girl up, but his arm was struck by a blue-white glow, causing him to quickly withdraw.
The rescue team was shocked, but the girl slowly stood up, saying, "I'll go with you, but don't try to touch me again."

Considerate and wise, Hedwig hails from Norway, where her name signifies a beautiful woman who leads you to victory.
Her tactical advice is always invaluable, so trust that your victory will soon be guided by her.

Ninjas only emerge during wartime.
Thus, descendants of ninja families born in peaceful times often feel out of place.
At that time, Mugenki often imagined during training how he would showcase his skills and restore the prestige of the ninja clan if war broke out.
But when war truly arrived, he realized it was not the grand era he had envisioned; it was inferno.

Once an ordinary mercenary, he became a common death row inmate after countless killings.
During the first Abyss War, he killed all the Abysslings that invaded the prison, becoming a simple fugitive.
Now, he is a humble human resistance fighter, working alongside the Emerald Phoenix who once imprisoned him.
He no longer poses a threat to humanity, as the Emerald Phoenix personally handed him over to Wyard Steel, the current warden.

We, the Sperm Whale trio, are inseparable and will always be close and loving. How could they possibly have any dissatisfaction with me? Impossible (She smiles confidently).
Little Biter's original name? He doesn't need an original name. I call him Little Biter, and that's all he is, understand? (She smiles "kindly")

She is a player with an extremely high decibel level. Even when the battle reaches its peak and the artillery is roaring, her voice still echoes through the skies.
As a guerrilla, she is responsible for drawing enemy fire, and it's clear she's too competent at it. Often, allied soldiers are tempted to aim at her due to the noise.

As a child, he was frail and often ill, suffering a severe fever that left him with lasting health issues, feeling cold even near a furnace. Once, while trying to warm himself in his father's chemistry lab, he accidentally spilled reagents on himself and caught fire, feeling much better afterward.
As long as he burns, he feels energized. Within a few years, he transformed from emaciated to robust, and his personality shifted from introverted to bold and confident. Now, he is charismatic but struggles to connect with others.
It's said that a strange creature named Red Thorn has been looking for him recently.

On the battlefield, a "Queen Bee" soared into the air, her golden light shimmering continuously. The Abyssling's electronic eyes couldn't keep up with her, and the anti-air defenses were rhythmically destroyed by her.
Soon, her loyal swarm arrived, and the enemy ranks were obliterated in an instant.
Her drone squadron was custom-built for her by the Mechanic Henrique, utilizing nearly all the resources of the Sperm Whale organization. The inefficiency of this apocalyptic declaration of affection is outrageous.

In the early stages of the Abyss War, the Abyssling had only fully mechanized units, even the zombified human army was controlled by parasitic machine helmets.
It was the emergence of this entity that forced the Abyssling to develop genetic technology and deploy biochemical units on the battlefield.
Without this, you would witness large swathes of the Abyssling's mechanical Troop either paralyzed or turning on each other, completely losing combat effectiveness.
To the Abyssling's mechanical units, her hacking ability is as terrifying as a plague.

Even in this apocalyptic world, the Teutonic Knights persist, upholding the chivalric spirit to save lives.
Galahad often stands on the rocks gazing at the sea, hoping for holy light to guide him, part the ocean, and allow him to wield his sword into the Abyss Empire, ending this catastrophe.
He firmly believes that destiny has a reason for making him a knight, and since he bears the name of the Sacred Knight of Calamity, this unprecedented disaster will be concluded by him.
Don't worry about any enemies slipping through; they are already surrounded by her.

Throughout human history, there has been only one employee in a unique profession: the celestial demolitionist.
Renowned for his work in outer space, he has his own online channel with millions of viewers watching him blast asteroids of all sizes in the asteroid belt daily.
Now, he's returned to Earth, as there are finally opportunities here for him to showcase his skills.
This deep blue mecha excels in ocean combat. Tentacle monsters? Child's play. Like a shark, he'll show enemies who's the predator and who's prey, even though he's allergic to seafood.

She doesn't have pointed long ears, yet the troops still call her Little Lynx. During the First Abyss War, she was sent from the rear to support the front lines. Her exceptional mobility and support coordination made her popular on any battlefield she joined.
.So, although the Human Earth Alliance suffered heavy casualties, everyone loved Little Lynx.

People doubt the power of colors, especially in battle.
Yet, she, with her extraordinary perception of colors, can work wonders, harm foes, heal wounds, and materialize objects... as if colors become omnipotent in her hands.
The colors she sees differ vastly from those perceived by ordinary people, and her understanding of them is beyond mortal comprehension.
"Colors are magical mediums, spirits. Just because you can't see them, you can't understand," she explained.

Androids should be noble and beautiful works of art, not mass-produced or made carelessly, nor should they become tools for human laziness.
She should have thoughts, emotions, and love. She is imperfect, has a temper, and should not be bound by cold code to remain loyal to humans. Let her decide whether to use her power to protect or destroy us.
If you truly create her in the future... please name her Anna.
—Professor K's last words

When I was with the special forces, I aimed at people, and the moment I pulled the trigger, I was the taker, stripping away the target's future possibilities.
Now it's different. Whether it's those red war machines or genetically modified monsters, theoretically, they don't have plans or dreams for their future.
But then, how is this different from shooting at fixed targets?
So now I roam various battlefields. Yes, I still want to be the taker.

When night falls
I stand on high, listening
The "stars" swarm in the garden
While I hide in the dark
Listen, a "star" lands with a sound!
Don't walk barefoot on this grass
My garden is filled with fragments of "stars"!

No matter how dire the situation, as long as the pure white butterfly flutters ahead, the troops feel hope.
Countless brutal battles have made her gear increasingly heavy, and the intense energy radiation and massive calculations needed to wield weapons have worsened her condition.
She implanted a self-destruct bomb in her brain, fearing that one day an overload might drive her mad, causing her to turn her weapon on humanity.
To remove the bomb from her brain, wait for an exceptional commander she can trust to appear.
By the way, she's recently developed a strong dislike for flies.

Adam, the Chief Instructor, is enormous, but not as big as his temper.
Every soldier in the human resistance must endure his trials; only those who persevere become qualified warriors.
No matter how determined one is to fight, failing Adam's test means remaining a protected one forever. His lack of mercy is his form of mercy.

Henrique has mastered 80% of the Abyss Empire's technology. He can identify useful parts from any mechanical wreckage with just a touch. The mechanic claims this…
The human-like arms crossed on his chest are merely decorative. His true arms are a pair of massive mechanical ones extending from his back! Henrique then answered the reporter's question, clearing up the long-standing confusion.

Theron, a brilliant scholar, refused when his enigmatic mentor urged him to submit to AI beings.
.He stood firmly with humanity, persisting on the path of discovery despite AI's superior knowledge and technology.

Evelyn, oh Evelyn! My creator! I offer you my fervent core, engraved with your name. My reactor emits the glow of your signature color, and my storage is filled with your visage. I sculpt my core in your likeness, tirelessly calculating how to love you. You need not acknowledge or respond to me. I will always watch you, captivated by the exquisite tapestry of the truth seeker.

He leads the human resistance Sperm Whale and was once the Northern Warzone's chief commander during the First Abyss War.
He preserved humanity's last strength on Earth, saving many in peril.
Sperm Whale consistently destroys Abyss Empire strongholds through guerrilla tactics, rescuing human refugees.
Without explorers like you to change the desperate battle, Arthur's Sperm Whale would fight to the last soldier.

He was once a protector of the Enkei Studio, and as the massive mysterious airship primarily researched genetic technology and physical enhancement, it was normal for Murphy to become less human-like.
The day the Water City sank, the Enkei Studio drifted away from above the Water City.
Not long after, Murphy, with his head blown off, was thrown into the sea from the airship, and human medics struggled to save him.
Now he is a super warrior of the human faction, but he is unwilling to mention the past and has yet to reveal the terrifying secrets in that airship laboratory.

I am Evelyn, a devout believer in science, unmatched in my devotion, and this service will be rewarded.
I firmly believe I will exist in all dimensions, in the past, present, and future, consuming all truths I encounter, becoming omniscient and omnipotent.
I am not the mythical gatekeeper and key; I will surpass it.

I had my people dismantle the captured Abysslings and scatter their parts at the entrance of their fortress, just as I did to other gangs before.
When facing such enemies, any hesitation only emboldens them further.
So I am more ruthless than before.
Previously, it was to reclaim my territory; now, it is to reclaim humanity's land. I will always succeed.

After the establishment of the Northern Base, Sophia issued numerous decrees, including child labor, hard labor, heavy taxes, even abandoning the elderly and prohibiting childbirth. The base's populace was in uproar, calling her the Witch of Politics and expelling her.
Shortly after, other bases that implemented benevolent governance couldn't sustain themselves. The few who didn't starve sought refuge, and after hearing the refugees' accounts of the chaos in those bases, people realized who had ensured their base's stability and survival.
Her successor took the level and read Sophia's final decree before her departure: As the base can now operate positively, I order all survivors, not one is allowed to die, to persevere until this dark world returns to a human realm.

I vow my initial wish: to be born for salvation, may I descend.
I vow my temporary wish: to end war with killing, to protect life with my body.
I vow my lifelong wish: even if my body perishes, the wish to save the world shall endure.

Former naval leader Gustaf was always gloomy, saying his dream was to become a great pirate, yet he couldn't plunder humans, a contradiction that seemed to make his dream unattainable. Now it's different; after his navy was defeated by the Abyss Empire, he fulfilled his dream. Commanding a pirate ship is much easier than leading a military fleet, and he quickly became the Abyssling's maritime nightmare. Humans are no match for the Abyssling on land, yet he remains elusive at sea, repeatedly thwarting reinforcements sent by the Abyss Empire to the mainland.

No one knows what the world looks like through his profound gaze. To him, it's the reality: both humans and Abysslings are terminally ill. It's the path he believes in: anything can be "corrected" through his thorough surgery.
Cooperate with caution, but don't attempt to understand or get close to him. His unparalleled nano-medical skills are a disaster for the Abysslings when controlled.
In uncontrollable aspects, try to avoid his talents... We can only be grateful that he currently stands with humanity.

Since the crisis in the Water City erupted, the charismatic and wealthy Matilda established her own small nation, finding peace in a distant corner away from global conflicts.
After the first Abyss War broke out, her isolated nation continuously sheltered refugees, and this utopia, indulged in false tranquility, finally experienced the baptism of war.
The "subjects" protected their "queen" as they fled the fantasy realm she created, honing their skills amidst the flames of war.
Now, as the second Abyss War begins, Matilda still leads her subjects into battle with the same regal demeanor as before.
Consume Hero Shards to increase enhancement Lv., greatly boosting Hero stats and skill strength.
